scores.promotion: No promotion. Require consistent OOS lift over zero and drift, HAC-aware paired-loss evidence, regime stability, calibration and cost-adjusted tests.
scores.validation_method: three purged expanding chronological folds; alpha chosen by weighted mean MAE
scores.holdout_reuse_disclosure: This date range was previously evaluated under V5.3.1; it is not a fresh independent holdout and cannot establish prospective model edge.
scores.features: price-only BTC close returns, rolling volatility and trend
scores.regime_definition: bull/bear/range from close versus SMA200 and SMA200 20-session slope; ex ante
scores.target: log(Open[t+h+2]/Open[t+2]); signal after close t; one daily bar latency; entry future open

limitations: Ridge is challenger only; no automatic promotion.
Calibration and >=200 matured OOS forecasts per horizon are required before probabilities.
Regime slices are descriptive; no regime-specific inferential claim is made.
The reused historical holdout is continuity diagnostics only, not independent prospective evidence.
No cost-adjusted strategy PnL, funding, slippage or execution backtest is claimed.
No calibrated probability or live trading claim is permitted.

risk.reason: No predictive edge and cost-adjusted strategy value have been demonstrated; abstain.

audit.weakest_component: Prospective forecast evidence: no horizon has yet met the 200 matured forecast minimum required even to consider probabilistic calibration.
three_vulnerabilities: The historical 2025-11-16 to 2026-11-15 holdout was previously inspected under V5.3.1; it is not independent prospective evidence.
The predictive feature set remains price-only; derivatives, ETF flows, order flow, macro and on-chain data are not integrated.
No executable strategy backtest with fees, spread, slippage, funding, turnover and drawdown stress has been completed.
audit.falsifying_evidence: A prospective sample with >=200 matured forecasts per horizon that fails to beat the zero-return benchmark after multiple-testing control and realistic costs falsifies the proposed feature/model improvement.
audit.next_priority_experiment: V5.5-OHLCV-001: isolated volume-surprise and candle-geometry challenger; prospective ledger only.
